best_idea: Reconcile the playing ambient loops against the wanted emitters every frame (keep exact matches, re-aim the nearest leftover loop of the same sound, start new ones, stop the rest) so a loop never restarts on a tick, with a channel budget that reserves some voices.
decision_why: Keep the reconcile-and-reuse step and the reserved-channel budget for zone and ambience loops; fix the missing angle wrap, the loop budget that can starve one-shots and the cut on focus change; add the crossfade the donor lacks.
acceptance: A client unit test on reconcile: an unchanged emitter keeps its voice id across two calls, and emitters at 1 and 359 degrees are 2 degrees apart. A play test: the zone bed fades in over 900 ms and resumes where it left off on return.
